QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_45

question.text: Which category of AIF pays tax at the FUND level (pass-through not available for business income), impacting distributions to investors?

answer.text: No AIF pays tax at fund level

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.7 and cross-chapter context: Cat III AIFs pay tax at the fund level on business income (no pass-through under Section 115UB). This is why Ex 9.10 applies tax at fund level before distribution. The Trap: Options A and B have pass-through status under Sec 115UB. Option D is false. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B tests Cat III taxation extensively; III-A/C (Compliance) covers tax residency and DTAA. Manager's Pro-Tip: Cat III MAT/surcharge stacking makes tax-adjusted IRR meaningfully lower than pre-tax — LPs of Cat III are sensitive to this. GIFT City IFSC Cat III gets concessional tax — consider structure in jurisdiction decision.
